caseNameFull: McLane Tilton v. Felix M. Drennen, as Receiver, etc.
attorneys: Mr. Forney Johnston for appellant. Mr. H. L. Stevens and Mr. Joseph E. Johnson for appellee.

opinions.text: On consideration of the stipulation to reinstate this cause on the docket and reverse on confession of error, it is now here ordered that said cause be reinstated on the docket; and that the decree be reversed upon such confession of error.
